  # the daily direction view.  The query layer projects that separate gate.
  crypto_market_snapshot:

    policy_or_data_delta: soft
    expectation_pricing: soft
    macro_transmission: soft
    derivatives_crowding: soft
    market_regime_context: hard

    description: Identify the primary event, speaker or document, event time and revision status.
    importance: hard

    source_priority: [official, verified_web]
    allowed_fallbacks: [web.fetch, web.search, web.search.tavily]
    preferred_capabilities: [official.macro, web.fetch, web.search]
    freshness_seconds: 604800
    minimum_independent_sources: 1
    authority_floor: official
    confidence_cap: 0.45

    venue_required: false
    minimum_independence_groups: 1

    freshness_seconds: 86400
    minimum_independent_sources: 1
    authority_floor: official
    confidence_cap: 0.5
    accepted_metric_families: [policy.statement_delta, economic.release_delta]
    required_metric_families: []
    required_fields: [current, baseline, delta]
    required_event_offsets: [baseline, t0]

    field_units: {current: [text, number, percent], baseline: [text, number, percent], delta: [text, number, percentage_point, bps]}

    venue_required: false

    allowed_delay_classes: [realtime, delayed]
    semantic_policy_ref: crypto_macro.fact_semantics.v1#policy_or_data_delta

    importance: hard
    minimum_fact: true
    source_priority: [exchange, audited_aggregator, verified_web]
    allowed_fallbacks: [macro.expectation_pricing, market.cross_asset, web.search, web.search.tavily]

    minimum_independent_sources: 1

    freshness_seconds: 600
    minimum_independent_sources: 2
    authority_floor: exchange
    confidence_cap: 0.55
    accepted_metric_families: [macro.rates, macro.usd]
    required_metric_families: [macro.rates, macro.usd]

    venue_required: false
    minimum_independence_groups: 1
    allowed_delay_classes: [realtime]
    semantic_policy_ref: crypto_macro.fact_semantics.v1#cross_asset_confirmation
  - requirement_id: crypto.spot

    description: Observe BTC spot reaction, volume and the event-time comparison window.
    importance: hard
    minimum_fact: true
    source_priority: [exchange, audited_aggregator]
